entities.name: Kathryn O'Loughlin McCarthy
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kathryn Ellen O'Loughlin was a U.S. representative from Kansas. After her election, she was married to Daniel M. McCarthy, who served in the Kansas State Senate, and thereupon served under the name of Kathryn O'Loughlin McCarthy. She was the first woman elected to Congress from Kansas.
